Quick pricing note (internal): I modeled two options in price-impact-summary.xlsx — attaching high-level here. 

Option A — One-off top-up:
- 80 GPU-hours/week x 4 weeks = 320 GPU-hours total
- Unit price (on-demand-equivalent): $0.42 / GPU-hour => $134.40 total (example numbers)
- Billing: single invoice upon execution; no change to Order Form commitments.

Option B — Temporary addendum with minimum hedge:
- Addendum that increases weekly commit for 4 weeks at a discounted bump price; requires short amendment to Order Form but sets min commitment for that 4-week period.

Recommendation: Option A (simpler, procurement-friendly). If HealthLytics wants an invoice/PO, we can provide a one-line amendment referencing Exhibit X and an invoice. Laura — I've kept the math in the sheet.
